primaryChecks.text: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.previousContext: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.nextContext: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 町名がレビ人への割当地一覧に明記される。

primaryChecks.text: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 下町と上町の両方が固有名で記される。
